name: creanose-frontend
description: Prototipo de vistas móvil y web del sistema Escombro 0 — HTML5 semántico, CSS modular BEM + PostCSS, TypeScript

scripts.css: postcss src/styles/main.css -o dist/styles/main.css && postcss src/styles/tokens.css -o dist/styles/tokens.css && postcss src/styles/base.css -o dist/styles/base.css && postcss src/styles/components.css -o dist/styles/components.css
scripts.copy:assets: rm -rf dist/assets && mkdir -p dist/assets dist/styles && cp -r src/assets/* dist/assets/
scripts.build: pnpm run css && pnpm run js && pnpm run copy:assets && pnpm run html
scripts.dev: concurrently --names CSS,JS,HTML,SVR --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,magenta,green "pnpm run css:watch" "pnpm run js:watch" "pnpm run html:watch" "npx live-server dist --port=5000 --no-browser --watch=dist"
